name: Srikakulam
registryCustodian: Government of Andhra Pradesh Department of Survey, Settlements and Land Records via the official Bhunaksha AP service; district administration context is confirmed by the official Srikakulam site. City-specific open parcel coverage was not evidenced.
publicMapLead: APSAC official AP GIS cadastral maps wrapper, https://apsac.ap.gov.in/dashboard-staging/ap-cadastral-maps/, embedding an official Web AppBuilder application; its current config had no map item or operational layer URL.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Telugu discovery queries identified official Bhunaksha AP, the Srikakulam district site, and APSAC cadastral maps. The official service pages establish cadastral-map context, but neither query produced a usable anonymous Srikakulam parcel ID-plus-geometry service.
requestOutcomes: The Bhunaksha root and identified viewer route timed out under bounded anonymous HTTPS requests. The official Srikakulam site, APSAC wrapper, and APSAC Web AppBuilder config returned HTTP 200. Config inspection found empty map.itemId, generic default mapOptions, and no operational layer/service URL. No credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
